capabilities: Render ```sakura code blocks as colored directory trees
Detect folders from list nesting with inconsistent indentation or mixed tabs and spaces
Render pasted tree command output directly
Render Markdown bulleted lists as trees
extras: Full syntax reference is kept in a separate SYNTAX.md file rather than in the README; the plugin listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted to simplify designing file systems or other tree-like structures for documentation and presentations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render tree-like structures such as file system layouts as visual diagrams inside notes.
summary: Fenced code block renderer that turns indented lists in ```sakura blocks into color-coded directory tree diagrams.
